sets.description:
Alert — persistent, contextual message for a page or section (validation summary, account status, offline).

Use for persistent messages tied to a page/section (validation summary, account status, offline).
Don't for transient confirmations (Toast), blocking decisions (Modal), site-wide announcements (Banner), or more than 2 stacked alerts.
Accessibility: role="alert" only for urgent dynamic errors; otherwise role="status".

Code: <Alert variant color title onDismiss>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-alert--docs

Accordion — collapsible sections (Default, Flush, Separate cards, Multi-level, With sub-header).

Use for FAQs, long settings, progressive disclosure.
Don't hide content users must compare or read, nest >2 levels, or use as page navigation. Triggers are <button aria-expanded aria-controls>.
Accessibility: each header is a <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls; each panel is a role="region" labelled by its header.

Code: <Accordion variant>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-accordion--docs

Banner — site-wide, dismissible announcement strip (promo, cookie notice, maintenance, newsletter).

Use for site-wide, dismissible announcements.
Don't for contextual errors (Alert), action feedback (Toast), or more than one banner at a time. Persist dismissal.
Accessibility: a role="region" landmark with a label; the dismiss button has an aria-label; never put essential information only in a dismissable banner.

Code: <Banner>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-banner--docs

Badge — short status, category or count label (1–2 words).

Use for 1–2 word status, category, count or "New".
Don't as a clickable action, for sentences, or more than 2–3 per row.
Accessibility: plain text, so the label must make sense on its own ("3 unread", not "3"); never show status with colour alone.

Code: <Badge color size leading iconOnly circle>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-badge--docs

Download App Button — App Store / Google Play badge link for marketing pages.

Use for App Store and Google Play badges on marketing and landing pages.
Don't for in-app actions (Button) or ordinary links.
Accessibility: it is a link; the store name is visible text and the logo is decorative (aria-hidden).

Code: <DownloadAppButton store tone>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-downloadappbutton--docs

Button — triggers an action (submit, open overlay, start a flow).

Use: any action that changes state, submits, opens an overlay or starts a flow. One brand button per section; secondary/tertiary for the rest; danger for destructive confirmations; ghost in toolbars, rows, card headers; dark on light marketing sections; iconOnly for universal icons with aria-label + Tooltip.
Don't: navigation (use a link, or <a className={buttonVariants({...})}>); status display (Badge); view switching (Tabs/ButtonGroup); two brand buttons side by side; success/warning for ordinary primary actions; outline on brand/secondary/dark (use tertiary).
Accessibility: type="button" by default; loading = keep width, Spinner size="sm", aria-busy + disabled; prefer base+ on touch.

Code: <Button color size iconOnly outline logo>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-button--docs

Bottom navigation item — icon + label destination (Initial, Hover/active).

In code: part of <BottomNavigation>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-bottomnavigation--docs

Bottom navigation — mobile bar for 3–5 top-level destinations (Bordered, Action button, Pagination, Segment controls).

Use on mobile for 3–5 top-level destinations.
Don't on desktop, with >5 items, or for actions (except one center action).
Accessibility: a <nav> with an aria-label; the active item has aria-current; every item keeps a text label, never icon only.

Code: <BottomNavigation variant>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-bottomnavigation--docs

Bottom bar (desktop) — call and media-player control bars.

In code: part of <BottomNavigation>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-bottomnavigation--docs

Button group — joined row of Secondary (Gray) or Tertiary (White) buttons for 2–5 related actions or a compact view switcher.

Use for 2–5 closely related actions or a compact view switcher.
Don't for unrelated actions, primary CTAs, or >5 options. If it switches content panels, use Tabs variant="segmented" for ARIA.
Accessibility: the wrapper is role="group" with an aria-label; toggle groups set aria-pressed on each button; icon-only items need an aria-label.

Code: <ButtonGroup size color>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-buttongroup--docs

Button group examples — ready-made compositions (icons, numbers, plus & minus, with dropdown/badge, vertical).

In code: part of <ButtonGroup>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-buttongroup--docs

Breadcrumb — location in a hierarchy ≥3 levels deep (Default, Background, dropdown, group buttons, badge).

Use in hierarchies ≥ 3 levels deep.
Don't as primary navigation, for linear flows (Stepper), or on top-level pages.
Accessibility: a <nav> with an aria-label around an ordered list; the last item has aria-current="page"; separators are aria-hidden.

Code: <Breadcrumb variant>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-breadcrumb--docs

Breadcrumb item — link with optional icon and separator (Initial, Hover, Active = current page).

In code: part of <Breadcrumb>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-breadcrumb--docs

Card — groups information about one entity (product, post, profile, plan, KPI); 15 layouts.

Use to group information about one entity (products, posts, profiles, plans, KPIs).
Don't wrap every section in a card, nest cards, or put cards inside a Modal. Whole-card links: one stretched <a>, no nested interactive elements.
Accessibility: a plain container, so give its title a real heading; if the whole card is clickable, use one stretched link, never nested links or buttons.

Code: <Card>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-card--docs

Bubble content — text, file, audio, calendar, image grid, link preview.

In code: part of <ChatBubble>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-chatbubble--docs

Bubble — message container. Orientation=Right is used by received messages, Orientation=Left (brand-tinted) by sent messages; Clean = no fill.

In code: part of <ChatBubble>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-chatbubble--docs

Chat bubble — conversational message row with avatar (Text, File, Audio, Calendar, Images, URL × received Left / sent Right).

Use for conversational UIs.
Don't for threaded comments/forums (List + Avatars) or notifications.
Accessibility: sender and time are visible text; action buttons have aria-labels; decorative icons are aria-hidden.

Code: <ChatBubble direction clean width>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-chatbubble--docs

Carousel — slides of equivalent visual items or testimonials.

Use sparingly for galleries of equivalent visual items or testimonials.
Don't hide important content in later slides, auto-advance without pause, or use as the key hero message.
Accessibility: a group with aria-roledescription="carousel"; previous, next and indicator buttons have aria-labels and the active indicator has aria-current; slide changes are announced through aria-live; never autoplay without a pause control.

Code: <Carousel variant>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-carousel--docs

Carousel control — previous/next button on imagery (overlay-light fill).

In code: part of <Carousel>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-carousel--docs

Carousel indicator — slide dot (Initial, Active).

In code: part of <Carousel>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-carousel--docs

Device mockups — phone, tablet, laptop, desktop, watch frames for product screenshots on marketing pages.

Use on marketing pages to present product screenshots.
Don't inside the product UI.
Accessibility: the frame is decorative; with a label it becomes role="img" with that label, otherwise give the screenshot inside its own alt text.

Code: <DeviceMockup device>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-devicemockup--docs

Drawer — side or bottom panel for secondary tasks that keep page context (filters, details, create/edit forms, mobile navigation).

Use for secondary tasks that keep page context: filters, details, create/edit forms, mobile navigation.
Don't for quick confirmations (Modal), desktop primary navigation (Sidebar), or content that needs its own URL.
Accessibility: a native <dialog> labelled by its title (aria-labelledby), so focus stays inside and Esc closes it; the close button has an aria-label; focus returns to the trigger.

Code: <Drawer>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-drawer--docs

Drawer heading — title row with close button (heading, logo, icon, avatar, user group, breadcrumb).

In code: part of <Drawer>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-drawer--docs

Drawer footer — action row (two buttons, buttons & links, three buttons, confirm).

In code: part of <Drawer>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-drawer--docs

Dropdown item — menu row (16 types × Initial/Hover/Disabled).

In code: part of <Dropdown>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-dropdown--docs

Dropdown header — user/info block at the top of a menu.

In code: part of <Dropdown>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-dropdown--docs

Dropdown menu — list of actions or options revealed from a trigger (16 layouts: profile, separators, radio/checkbox/toggle, users, scroll, grid, language).

Use for actions or navigation options revealed from a trigger (row actions, user menu, "More"); checkbox/radio/toggle variants for in-menu filters and settings.
Don't for form values (Select/Autocomplete), >12 items without search, always-needed actions, or nested submenus deeper than one level.
Accessibility: role="menu"/menuitem (or menuitemcheckbox/menuitemradio), arrow keys, Esc returns focus.

Code: <Dropdown>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-dropdown--docs

Dropdown triggers — Button, Ghost button, icon button, Avatar, Avatar & name, Link.

In code: part of <Dropdown>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-dropdown--docs

Input form — Label + Input field + Helper stack (gap 10px).

In code: part of <Input>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-input--docs

Select form — choose one value from 5+ known options.

Use for one value from 5+ known options.
Don't for ≤4 options (Radio/ChoiceCard), actions (Dropdown), or long/remote lists (Autocomplete). Prefer native <select> unless custom rendering is needed.
Accessibility: a native <select>, so keyboard and screen-reader support come from the browser; always give it a Label; set aria-invalid together with an error helper.

Code: <Select size>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-select--docs

Search form — filter/search content (with search/filters buttons).

Use for filtering/searching content.
Don't for picking a form value (Autocomplete). Wrap in <form role="search">, type="search".
Accessibility: wrapped in a role="search" landmark; the input needs a label (visible or aria-label); the submit icon button has an aria-label.

Code: <SearchInput variant>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-searchinput--docs

Number form — small bounded integers with steppers (quantity, guests).

Use for small bounded integers (quantity, guests).
Don't for IDs, phone or card numbers (Input inputMode="numeric") or wide ranges (RangeSlider).
Accessibility: the minus and plus buttons have aria-labels and aria-controls the input; the input keeps native arrow-key stepping; pair it with a Label.

Code: <NumberInput variant>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-numberinput--docs

Phone form — phone number with country dial-code selector.

Use when the dial code matters.
Don't for generic numbers.
Accessibility: the country code and the number each have a label; format hints go in helper text linked by aria-describedby; errors set aria-invalid.

Code: <PhoneInput>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-phoneinput--docs

Copy to clipboard form — read-only value with copy action (API keys, links, codes).

Use for API keys, share links, codes; announce "Copied" via aria-live.
Don't for editable values.
Accessibility: the copy button has an aria-label; the "Copied" confirmation is announced through an aria-live region.

Code: <CopyInput variant>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-copyinput--docs

Input field — single-line text control (4 sizes, 7 states).

Use for single-line free text: names, emails, URLs, search terms, numbers without steppers.
Don't for long text (Textarea), known options (Select/Autocomplete/Radio), dates (Datepicker), on/off (Toggle), or read-only data that isn't a form value.
Accessibility: visible Label with htmlFor; errors via aria-invalid + aria-describedby → HelperText; don't rely on color alone.

Code: <Input size>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-input--docs

File upload — Default (single file in a form) or Advanced dropzone.

In code: part of <FileUpload>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-fileupload--docs

File upload dropzone — multiple files / media; states Initial, Hover, Disabled, Success, Danger.

Use Default for one file in a form; dropzone for multiple files or media.
Don't hide the real <input type="file"> from assistive tech.
Accessibility: built on a real <input type="file"> inside a <label>, so it works with keyboard and screen readers; put type and size limits in helper text linked by aria-describedby.

Code: <FileUpload variant>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-fileupload--docs

Tag input — free-form multiple values as chips (emails, keywords).

Use for free-form multiple values (emails, keywords).
Don't when values come from a fixed list (multi-select Autocomplete or Checkbox group).
Accessibility: Enter adds a tag and Backspace removes the last one; each tag's remove button has an aria-label naming the tag; errors set aria-invalid.

Code: <TagInput size>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-taginput--docs

OTP input box — one-time code digit (4 sizes, 7 states).

Use for one-time codes (4–8 characters) with autocomplete="one-time-code", paste support, auto-advance.
Don't for passwords or general numbers.
Accessibility: the fields sit in a role="group" with a label; each digit field has its own aria-label; typing moves focus forward and Backspace moves back. An empty box between filled ones is a space in value, so clearing one box never shifts the others.

Code: <OtpInput size>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-otpinput--docs

OTP form examples — 4–8 digit code entry with optional separators.

In code: part of <OtpInput>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-otpinput--docs

Textarea — multi-line plain text (comments, descriptions); toolbar variants for chat/comments.

Use for multi-line plain text.
Don't for single-line values or formatted content (RichTextEditor).
Accessibility: pair it with a Label; set aria-invalid together with an error helper; toolbar buttons, when shown, have aria-labels.

Code: <Textarea>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-textarea--docs

Rich text editor — multi-line text with formatting toolbar.

Use when users must format text.
Don't for plain comments.
Accessibility: the editing area is role="textbox" with aria-multiline; formatting buttons sit in a role="toolbar" and each has an aria-label.

Code: <RichTextEditor>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-richtexteditor--docs

sets.figmaName: Textarea input ready to use examples
sets.description:
Textarea examples — Label + Textarea + Helper compositions.

In code: part of <Textarea>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-textarea--docs

Label — form field label (required asterisk, info icon, hint).

Use a Label on every control, and HelperText under it for hints and validation messages.
Don't use placeholder text as the label or put errors only in colour.
Accessibility: always pair Label htmlFor with the input id; link helper and error text to the input with aria-describedby; required fields show the marker and set required.

Code: <Label required hint>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-input--docs

Helper — helper/validation text under a field (12px).

Use a Label on every control, and HelperText under it for hints and validation messages.
Don't use placeholder text as the label or put errors only in colour.
Accessibility: always pair Label htmlFor with the input id; link helper and error text to the input with aria-describedby; required fields show the marker and set required.

Code: <HelperText>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-input--docs

Floating label input — label floats inside the field (Default/underline, With background/filled, Bordered/outlined).

Use in compact forms (login, checkout).
Don't mix with standard labelled inputs in the same form or use in long forms.
Accessibility: the floating text is a real <label> and stays the accessible name; never replace it with a placeholder; errors set aria-invalid.

Code: <FloatingLabelInput variant size>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-floatinglabelinput--docs

Datepicker cell — day/month/year cell (Initial, Hover, Active, range start/between/end, Outlined = today, Disabled).

In code: part of <Datepicker>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-datepicker--docs

Datepicker controls — month/year header with previous/next buttons.

In code: part of <Datepicker>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-datepicker--docs

Datepicker menu — calendar popover (Default, Range, Year, Month, Day/Year/Month pickers).

In code: part of <Datepicker>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-datepicker--docs

Datepicker — pick a date or range near "now" (bookings, due dates).

Use for picking dates near "now".
Don't for birthdays/far-past dates (Selects or masked Input) or month-only values (Month/Year picker variant).
Accessibility: the calendar is a role="dialog" holding a role="grid" of days; arrow keys move between days and Enter selects; today is aria-current and the chosen day aria-selected; month changes are announced through aria-live.

Code: <Datepicker mode>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-datepicker--docs

Timepicker input — time field with clock icon (add-on variants, 4 sizes, 7 states).

In code: part of <Timepicker>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-timepicker--docs

Timepicker — pick a time of day or a booking slot (single or range).

Use for times of day or slot booking.
Don't for durations (NumberInput + unit Select). Prefer native type="time" when slot UI isn't required.
Accessibility: the fields are grouped in a fieldset with a legend; each field has a label; errors set aria-invalid.

Code: <Timepicker>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-timepicker--docs

Timepicker menu — slot list, time input, or slider popovers.

In code: part of <Timepicker>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-timepicker--docs

Autocomplete — type to pick from a large or remote list (users, cities, tags).

Use to pick from a large or remote list with typing.
Don't for <10 static options (Select). Implement combobox ARIA (role="combobox", aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant).
Accessibility: follows the combobox pattern: the input is role="combobox" with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant; arrow keys move through the listbox options and Enter selects.

Code: <Autocomplete>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-autocomplete--docs

Autocomplete menu — suggestion listbox (Default, CTA, save option, advanced, categories).

In code: part of <Autocomplete>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-autocomplete--docs

Autocomplete item — suggestion row (Initial, Hover, Disabled).

In code: part of <Autocomplete>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-autocomplete--docs

Range slider — approximate value(s) in a bounded range (price filter, volume).

Use for approximate values in a bounded range.
Don't when an exact number is needed (NumberInput) or for more than two thumbs.
Accessibility: each thumb is role="slider" with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext; arrow keys step the value; every thumb needs an aria-label.

Code: <RangeSlider value>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-rangeslider--docs

Range slider helper — min/max labels.

In code: part of <RangeSlider>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-rangeslider--docs

Range slider bar — track + filled range.

In code: part of <RangeSlider>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-rangeslider--docs

Range slider thumb — Initial / Active.

In code: part of <RangeSlider>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-rangeslider--docs

Toggle switch — binary setting that applies immediately (base, lg).

Use for settings that apply immediately.
Don't inside forms submitted later (Checkbox), for choosing between named options (Tabs/Radio), or for actions. role="switch" + aria-checked.
Accessibility: role="switch" with aria-checked; the visible label is the accessible name and is clickable; Space toggles it.

Code: <Toggle size checked>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-toggle--docs

Toggle inputs — toggle with label/helper, icons, card and segmented-control layouts.

In code: part of <Toggle>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-toggle--docs

Toggle label.

In code: part of <Toggle>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-toggle--docs

Toggle helper text.

In code: part of <Toggle>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-toggle--docs

Toggle group — stacked settings list.

In code: part of <Toggle>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-toggle--docs

Checkbox / Radio input — Checkbox for independent opt-ins and multi-select; Radio for one of 2–5 visible options.

Use for opt-ins inside a form that is submitted later, and for picking several items from a list (radios: exactly one of a few).
Don't for mutually exclusive options or instant settings.
Accessibility: real <input> elements inside a <label>; group radios in a fieldset with a legend; never show the checked state with colour alone.

Code: <Checkbox checked>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-checkbox--docs

Checkbox / Radio form (choice cards) — options that need description or visuals (plans, payment, shipping). The whole card is the label.

Use when options need description or visuals (plans, payment, shipping).
Don't for short simple labels. The whole card is the <label> around a real input.
Accessibility: real radio or checkbox inputs inside a fieldset with a legend; the whole card is the label, so clicking anywhere selects it.

Code: <ChoiceCard variant>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-choicecard--docs

Checkbox / Radio group — stacked or grid groups of choices inside a fieldset with legend.

In code: part of <ChoiceCard>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-choicecard--docs

Checkbox / Radio label.

In code: part of <Checkbox>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-checkbox--docs

Checkbox / Radio helper text.

In code: part of <Checkbox>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-checkbox--docs

Gallery — browsable image collection (grids, featured, carousel, filters, masonry).

Use for browsable image collections.
Don't for a single hero image or product listings with data (Cards).
Accessibility: every image needs alt text; the active filter has aria-current; carousel controls have aria-labels.

Code: <Gallery variant>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-gallery--docs

Icon shape — decorative coloured container for an icon (6 sizes × 7 colours × circle/square).

Use as a decorative container for icons (feature lists, toasts, steppers, empty states).
Don't as a button or for people. aria-hidden.
Accessibility: decorative (aria-hidden), so its meaning must also be in nearby text.

Code: <IconShape size color shape>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-iconshape--docs

Jumbotron — landing-page hero with one message and ≤2 CTAs (heading + CTA, background image, illustration, form, gradient, navbar, bento).

Use as the first section of landing pages with one message and CTA.
Don't inside app screens, stack heroes, or show more than 2 CTAs.
Accessibility: its headline is the page's single h1; decorative art is aria-hidden; text over images must keep 4.5:1 contrast.

Code: <Jumbotron variant>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-jumbotron--docs

List item — 11 row types (icons, numbers, badges, images, transactions) × Initial/Hover/Disabled.

In code: part of <List>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-list--docs

List — vertically stacked items with 1–3 attributes (Default, Divider, Card, CTA).

Use for stacked items with 1–3 attributes.
Don't for comparable multi-column data (Table) or media-rich blocks (Card grid). Use <ul>/<li>.
Accessibility: a semantic <ul>; interactive rows are focusable and disabled rows set aria-disabled; icons are aria-hidden.

Code: <List variant>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-list--docs

Modal — blocking dialog for decisions or short focused tasks (confirm, sign in, short forms ≤6 fields).

Use for decisions or short focused tasks that block the page (confirm destructive actions, ≤ ~6 fields, acknowledgements).
Don't for long forms or content needing page context (Drawer/page), non-blocking info, modal-in-modal, or auto-open on load.
Accessibility: role="dialog" aria-modal aria-labelledby, focus trap, Esc/backdrop close (except destructive), return focus.

Code: <Modal>
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-modal--docs

Modal header — title row with close (icon, breadcrumb, avatars, logo, supporting text).

In code: part of <Modal>.
Docs: https://ad-design-kit-storybook.netlify.app/?path=/docs/components-modal--docs

Modal footer — actions row (buttons, buttons & links, three buttons, pagination).

In code: part of <Modal>.
